title: Google AI Code Masterclass
full_monologue: **Google's new AI can write code better than senior engineers.** Imagine an AI that doesn’t just assist, but outperforms humans in coding. It’s learning from millions of lines of code, adapting in real-time, and producing clean, efficient solutions faster than any developer. This isn’t just a tool—it’s a game-changer for the future of software development. But what does this mean for programmers? Will AI replace us, or will it elevate our work? Let me know in the comments.
